questions.question: Can you speed up the site I already have?
questions.answer: Usually, yes. I start with an audit to find what's slowing it down, then fix the biggest causes first and measure the difference.

questions.question: Do you use page builders?
questions.answer: No. I build custom blocks, so you can edit content freely without the extra weight a page builder adds.

questions.question: How much does it cost?
questions.answer: It depends on the scope, so every project is priced in a proposal after a short call and a written scope.
